summary: Jinja2 filters transform variable values in templates, e.g. capitalize, to_yaml and to_json; Ansible adds many more.
questions: How do I transform a variable's value in a template?

answer_card.title: Transforming variables with filters
answer_card.answer_md: Apply filters inside expressions, e.g. `{{ name | capitalize }}`, `{{ data | to_yaml }}`, `{{ data | to_json }}`. Jinja2 has many built-in filters and Ansible adds more.
